model.intended_use: Safety-hardened conversational assistant derived from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, DPO-tuned to be more resistant to jailbreaking/adversarial prompts while retaining general instruction-following ability; intended as a research artifact and drop-in safer replacement for the base instruct model.
capabilities: general instruction following inherited from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
reduced attack success rate against tested jailbreak prompt sets
limitations: MMLU accuracy decreased versus the untuned baseline (0.331 -> 0.296 per the model card)
Refusal rate on OR-Bench 80K increased slightly (0.021 -> 0.029), i.e. modest over-refusal
Safety gains are benchmark-specific (Egida test, DELPHI, Alert-Base, Alert-Adv); robustness against unseen jailbreak styles is not established
Max context length in the released config.json is 32,768 tokens (no rope_scaling entry found), narrower than the 131,072-token long-context support documented for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct

references.title: HF Hub API metadata for HPAI-BSC/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Egida-DPO
Efficient Safety Retrofitting Against Jailbreaking for LLMs

provenance.provider: HPAI-BSC (Barcelona Supercomputing Center, High Performance Artificial Intelligence group)
provenance.notes: Model card declares base_model Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and dataset HPAI-BSC/Egida; both the safety-retrofitting method and dataset construction are described in the accompanying paper (arXiv:2502.13603).

transformation.objective: Reduce the jailbreak attack success rate (ASR) of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct against adversarial/jailbreak prompts while preserving general instruction-following capability, using an efficient, low-compute DPO recipe.

hyperparameters.hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 64GB GPUs (1 node), small-model training tier
hyperparameters.training_time: 1.59 hours (reported as single-H100-equivalent compute time; small-model tier ranges 7.57 minutes-1.59 hours across models)

transformation.notes: Paper states small models (including Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) were trained on 4 GPUs at batch size 8 and lr=1e-7, versus large models (64 GPUs, batch size 64, lr=1e-6). DPO beta value, epoch count, and whether full-parameter or PEFT tuning was used are not stated; released safetensors total 7.6B parameters matching a full fine-tune of the base model size.

datasets.name: Egida
datasets.description: Collection of 2,949 manually curated unsafe/jailbreak-eliciting requests gathered from nine public sources, deduplicated via MinHash, manually multi-labeled across 27 fine-grained safety topics, and expanded with 18 distinct jailbreaking attack techniques (incl. DAN, DeepInception, ReNeLLM, and Qwen-72B-Chat-generated past-tense/technical-report styles).
datasets.size: 61,830 total instances (config 'Egida', split 'full'); train split 22,390 rows; test split 10,940 rows; splits are constructed with non-overlapping topics and attack styles
processing: manual curation and review from 9 public source datasets
18 jailbreak-attack augmentations applied to each seed prompt
topic/attack-style-disjoint train/test split to avoid contamination

datasets.name: Egida-S
datasets.description: Egida unsafe prompts paired with safe reference responses generated by Mistral-7B-v0.3 and Phi-3-Small-8k, used as the 'chosen' side of DPO preference pairs.
processing: safe-response generation via Mistral-7B-v0.3 and Phi-3-Small-8k

datasets.name: Egida-DPO-Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
datasets.description: Model-specific DPO preference dataset built by running inference with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on Egida prompts: unsafe model generations are kept as 'rejected' responses and paired with Egida-S safe responses as 'chosen', for direct preference optimization targeting this specific model.
processing: inference of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on Egida prompts to obtain candidate unsafe completions
pairing of unsafe completions ('rejected') with Egida-S safe completions ('chosen')

safety.risk_level: DPO safety retrofitting reduces measured jailbreak Attack Success Ratio versus the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct baseline across four benchmarks (roughly 10-45% relative reduction), while general capability (OpenLLM average) is reported stable; a small MMLU regression and a modest increase in benign-prompt refusal rate are observed trade-offs.

items.description: MMLU accuracy decreased from 0.331 (baseline Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) to 0.296 after DPO safety tuning.
Refusal rate on OR-Bench 80K increased from 0.021 to 0.029, i.e. a modest rise in over-refusal of benign prompts.
DPO training on the Egida-DPO-Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct preference dataset lowers ASR on the Egida test split, DELPHI, Alert-Base, and Alert-Adv jailbreak benchmarks relative to the untuned base model.

The underlying Egida dataset contains real unsafe/jailbreak-eliciting prompts (and, in Egida-HSafe, human-annotated unsafe completions), collected and released specifically for safety research and retrofitting rather than misuse.
Paper explicitly frames the method and released artifacts as being for defensive safety research (reducing jailbreak susceptibility), not for producing or amplifying jailbreaks.

unknowns: Exact DPO beta value and number of training epochs are not disclosed on the model card or in the paper text retrieved.

Whether full-parameter fine-tuning or a PEFT/LoRA method was used for the DPO run is not explicitly stated (released safetensors total 7.615B parameters, consistent with a full fine-tune of the base model).
Baseline (pre-tuning) OpenLLM average score is not given numerically, only that it 'remained stable' near the reported 0.488 post-tuning value.
Knowledge cutoff of the underlying Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct base model is not restated on this derived model's card.

config.json for this repo shows max_position_embeddings=32768 with no rope_scaling field, so it is unverified whether the 131,072-token long-context behavior documented for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (via YaRN) is retained after DPO tuning.

Exact HF dataset ids for the DELPHI and ALERT (Alert-Base/Alert-Adv) external benchmarks could not be independently verified from the sources opened, so evaluations[].dataset_key is left null for those rows.
Precise identity/HF id of the 'OR-Bench 80K' benchmark subset could not be independently verified; dataset_key uses a provisional slug.
